caption: The drawing depicts two stylized human-like figures in black with red and white outlines, positioned side by side with their arms raised and angled outward. Both figures have large, rounded extensions at the lower body, giving them a bulbous appearance. Above and partially behind the figures is an irregular cream-colored shape bordered in red, with two intersecting stick-like symbols in red located near the top center. To the left of the figures is an oval shape with a red interior and white outline, sitting on a black shape with radiating short lines, resembling a sunburst or wheel. The central structure, which the figures appear to be standing on, is a curved band outlined in red and white, from which multiple elongated, tubular shapes hang downward, ending in rounded tips, with some featuring spiked lines radiating from the ends. The entire composition is set against a roughly rectangular, textured tan background, with the artwork itself centered and bordered by a plain, lighter tan margin. The color palette is limited to shades of black, red, cream, and tan, with distinct lines and areas of stippled shading.
title: Petroglyph - Human Figures
